name: Killjoys
description: An action-packed adventure series following a fun-loving, hard living trio of interplanetary bounty hunters (a.k.a. Killjoys) sworn to remain impartial as they chase deadly warrants around the Quad, a system of planets on the brink of revolution.

videos.title: Bangarang
videos.overview: Dutch and John are in a race against time, and a competing Killjoy, to save D'avin's life and clear their names.

videos.title: The Sugar Point Run
videos.overview: A hostage exchange with a vengeful warlord turns deadly when the Killjoys find themselves stranded in ‘Sugar Point’ – a restricted, bombed-out city on Westerley overrun with dangerous gangs and scavengers.

videos.title: The Harvest
videos.overview: A warrant to retrieve a missing migrant worker on Leith isn't as simple as it seems when the Killjoys discover something dangerous lurking beyond the edge of a farm. Meanwhile, a psych exam brings into question whether D'avin is mentally fit to do the job.

videos.title: Vessel
videos.overview: The Killjoys find their real rhythm as a trio while navigating the ugly side of Qreshi politics as they transport a group of gorgeous Surrogates in a bullet-riddled ride from a badlands fortress.

videos.title: A Glitch in the System
videos.overview: An easy salvage job on an abandoned ship takes an insidious turn when the Killjoys discover they are not alone and find themselves having to confront their deepest, darkest secrets.

videos.title: One Blood
videos.overview: Top Killjoys from around the Quad are pitted against one another in a race to find Big Joe, a legendary bounty hunter gone rogue.

videos.title: Kiss Kiss, Bye Bye
videos.overview: Attempts to uncover the mystery behind D'avin's missing memories sees the Killjoys making their way to an underground black market which triggers a shocking incident that will haunt the team.

videos.title: Come the Rain
videos.overview: A toxic Black Rain storm causes John and Pawter to take shelter in the Royale overrun with a gang of dangerous criminals. Dutch and D'avin are stuck on Lucy as they come perilously close to the eye of the storm.

videos.title: Enemy Khlyen
videos.overview: The Killjoys manage to turn the tables on Khlyen, only to find out the shocking truth behind his presence in the Quad. Dutch wonders if she was ever free.

videos.title: Escape Velocity
videos.overview: Tensions boil over when the Company arrests a friend and peace in the Quad hangs in the balance. The Killjoys must choose a side.

videos.title: Dutch and the Real Girl
videos.overview: Having failed to rescue D'avin, Dutch and Johnny make their way to Eulogy in the hopes of stealing a mysterious, high-tech shield.

videos.title: Wild, Wild Westerley
videos.overview: With D'avin back on the team, the Killjoys return to the ruins of Old Town to hunt eight escaped convicts.

videos.title: Shaft
videos.overview: A rescue mission goes sideways when the team encounters an unexpected enemy in an abandoned mine.

videos.title: Schooled
videos.overview: The team discovers that students have mysteriously disappeared from a school for gifted children on Westerly.

videos.title: Meet the Parents
videos.overview: Johnny joins Pawter for a chilly family reunion; D'avin experiences surprising side effects from the Red 17 experiments.

videos.title: I Love Lucy
videos.overview: In order to anticipate the coming danger that's been foretold, Dutch  goes on the hunt for green plasma. Her journey takes the team onto the  ship of an intergalactic trader who might know more about the impending  doom than they originally thought.

videos.title: Heart-Shaped Box
videos.overview: The team are tested to the core as tensions rise while Dutch  interrogates a lethal Level Six agent he captured and Johnny secretly  investigates Jelco's wall for Pawter.

videos.title: Full Metal Monk
videos.overview: Khlyen's Red 17 transmission leads Dutch, D'avin and Alvis to a research  facility on Arkyn; Johnny and Pawter try to rally support for the  impending war for Westerly.

videos.title: Johnny Be Good
videos.overview: Pawter's plans to free Old Town from Jelco's control get Dutch seized by an angry mob.

videos.title: How to Kill Friends and Influence People
videos.overview: The Killjoys and an old enemy join forces in a desperate bid to thwart Level Six's plan's for The Quad.

videos.title: Boondoggie
videos.overview: Dutch and D'Avin start making plans to take the fight to the Hullen while John searches for Clara and gains a new ally.

videos.title: A Skinner, Darkly
videos.overview: Dutch and D'avin attempt to train a replacement nerd; John finds his search for Clara is getting under some people's skin.

videos.title: The Hullen Have Eyes
videos.overview: The Killjoys trace the last coordinates of a Black Root ship to a radiation scorched planet, finding an abandoned Hullen training camp, creepy inhabitants and a surprising connection to their past.

videos.title: The Lion, the Witch & the Warlord
videos.overview: An ambush sends Dutch and Johnny on the run for help; D'avin tries to get to the bottom of a Black Warrant.

videos.title: Attack the Rack
videos.overview: The Killjoy rebels take drastic measures to clean house with a secret attack against the Rack.

videos.title: Necropolis Now
videos.overview: As Johnny faces off with someone from his past, Dutch faces her own personal hell.

videos.title: The Wolf You Feed
videos.overview: Desperate for an advantage, Dutch goes AWOL and risks a dangerous procedure that connects her to Aneela's memories.

videos.title: Heist, Heist, Baby
videos.overview: As the Killjoys plan a theft on an armored convoy, Aneela finds herself on a desperate search for Delle Seyah.

videos.title: Reckoning Ball
videos.overview: Johnny confronts his nemesis face to face when Delle Seyah suddenly arrives to set terms of war via parley.

videos.title: Wargasm
videos.overview: The Killjoy militia has everything they need to go to war, but as the battle begins, Aneela changes the entire game.

videos.title: The Warrior Princess Bride
videos.overview: Trapped in the mysterious and mind-bending greenspace and on the run from the deadly Lady, Aneela and her father Khlyen struggle to stay one step ahead while keeping a wounded Dutch alive.

videos.title: Johnny Dangerously
videos.overview: With criminals chasing an injured Johnny, D'av and Delle Seyah take drastic measures to save him.

videos.title: Bro-d Trip
videos.overview: Johnny manipulates D'av into helping him find a green pool. Zeph faces possible death.

videos.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting... An Alien Parasite
videos.overview: Dutch awakens to John at the brink of madness and the birth of D'av's child.

videos.title: Greening Pains
videos.overview: With D'av's newborn son's life on the line, the trio take desperate measures to save him.

videos.title: Baby, Face Killer
videos.overview: Team Awesome Force faces off with a relentless, deadly assassin whose arrival is triggered by their examination of the memory Khlyen altered in Dutch's mind. While Pree searches for his missing husband on Westerley, Zeph struggles to save Pip from an unexpected medical complication.

videos.title: O Mother, Where Art Thou
videos.overview: With D'avin having left, Dutch and John are left to follow the hidden pulsar in Khlyen's mysterious story that leads them to discover an unexpected past – including the origins of the assassin.

videos.title: It Takes a Pillage
videos.overview: An awkward Jaqobis homecoming takes a deadly turn as Dutch and Zeph risk everything for science.

videos.title: The Kids Are Alright
videos.overview: Team Awesome Force sneaks onto the RAC to rescue Westerly's stolen children; Zeph and Pip grow closer.

videos.title: Sporemageddon
videos.overview: Dutch braces herself for a final confrontation in greenspace in an attempt to stop The Lady from breaking through into the Quad and the rest of the universe. Back in the Quad and buried in her work, Zeph makes a horrifying discovery of a threat to all of Westerley.

videos.title: Run, Yala, Run
videos.overview: Dutch realizes The Lady has put Westerley under a collective delusion - in a world without memory, nothing is what it seems.

videos.title: Blame It on the Rain
videos.overview: Awake from the memory matrix, Dutch is determined to wake her friends and stop The Lady, before it's too late.

videos.title: Three Killjoys and a Lady
videos.overview: After escaping The Lady's clutches and reuniting with Lucy, the Killjoy trio start to wonder if there is a traitor amongst them.

videos.title: Ship Outta Luck
videos.overview: The Killjoy trio must figure out a way to breakout from an inescapable maximum security prison.

videos.title: A Bout, A Girl
videos.overview: Dutch enters the deadly Supermax prison and fights his way to the top as he seeks a chance to take over the entire ship.

videos.title: Three Mutineers
videos.overview: Dutch's prison takeover is thwarted by an unexpected hostage situation, leaving her, D'avin and John scrambling for a new plan.

videos.title: Cherchez La Bitch
videos.overview: The team goes undercover on a Leithian military base to help find The Lady's true body.

videos.title: Don't Stop Beweaving
videos.overview: Dutch and Zeph embark on a sisterly road trip to a dangerous cult on Leith to find the key to The Lady's destruction.

videos.title: Terraformance Anxiety
videos.overview: The Lady’s terraforming plans are becoming a reality, as the Killjoy trio scramble to find a way to defeat her.

videos.title: Last Dance
videos.overview: Dutch uses Khlyen to bait The Lady and finds herself in the midst of a final, epic showdown.
